g.text: One bar segment per quarter with any covered day (opacity = share of the quarter covered). Grey band = preliminary SDUD quarter
(2026 Q1). Quarterly resolution: starts inside a quarter appear as partial opacity.
13 states had Medicaid coverage of Wegovy/Zepbound in 2026 Q1; 5 states' coverage had ended or
Source: warehouse coverage table (state Medicaid documents). Coverage end dates after 2026 Q1 (RI, MA, UT) are future-dated and not shown as ended.
